question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Rustic
solution:
The correct answer is "Urbane."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "rustic" means typical of the country or of country people; simple. (देहाती, ग्रामीण (क्षेत्र या व्‍यक्तियों से संबंधित); सीधा-सादा)

 
 
• Example: *The whole area is full of **rustic**__ charm.*
 
 
 
• ​So, the antonym of **"Rustic"** is **"Urbane."**
 
• The word **"Urbane"** means (used especially about a man) good at knowing what to say and how to behave in social situations; appearing relaxed and confident. (भद्र, विनम्र, सुसभ्‍य; शांत और आत्‍मविश्‍वासपूर्ण लगने वाला)
 __
 
• **Example**: *Rohit was an **urbane**__, kindly, and generous man.*
 
 
 
• 
 
Hence, option 4 is the correct answer.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

• **Depressed: **very unhappy, often for a long period of time. (बहुत उदास (प्रायः लंबे समय तक))
 
• **Natural: **existing in nature; not made or caused by human beings. (प्रकृति में विद्यमान, प्राकृतिक, मानव-प्रेरित या निर्मित नहीं; नैसर्गिक)
 
• **Shallow: **not deep; with not much distance between top and bottom. (छिछला, गहरा नहीं; जिसकी ऊपरी सतह और तले के बीच दूरी कम हो)
